summary: Norway (NO) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Norwegian VAT codes, proportional VAT and electronic VAT returns, SAF-T export, remittance and OCR/KID bank payments, EHF/PEPPOL e-invoicing, recurring orders and payroll import. Use it for questions on what Norway adds to W1 and where Learn documents it.
overview:
Norway adds a large layer on top of W1 (354 objects, 240 fields added on W1 tables). VAT is the core: a single VAT Code on journals, ledger entries and posting setup, proportional deduction in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, extra fields on VAT Reporting Code, and a SAF-T export (codeunits 10670 to 10692, mapping and export pages, SAF-T versions 1.20 and 1.30) plus electronic VAT return submission with OAuth 2.0. Learn documents these as Norwegian VAT codes, proportional VAT, Norwegian VAT reporting and SAF-T setup.

Payments and banking are the second block. The remittance module (objects in the 15000000 range) handles payment suggestions, payment orders, waiting journal, return files and error codes. It is supported by fields on Vendor, Vendor Ledger Entry and Gen. Journal Line, SEPA export changes and pain.002/CAMT.054 import. KID, OCR and giro printing sit on Sales & Receivables Setup and the OCR objects.

Sales and e-invoicing cover EHF and PEPPOL BIS 3.0: GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields on customers and sales, reminder and finance charge documents, E-Invoice check and export codeunits, a PEPPOL30 NO set and Service document variants. Recurring orders, payroll import and a rule for applying entries in closed periods complete the local scope.
key_points: Norwegian VAT Code field on journals, ledger entries, G/L accounts and VAT Posting Setup, with VAT Reporting Code extended for reporting boxes and SAF-T VAT codes.
Proportional VAT: Calc. Prop. Deduction VAT and Proportional Deduction VAT % on VAT Posting Setup, posted through new procedures in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line.
SAF-T export with account and VAT mapping, setup wizard, data check, versions 1.20 and 1.30, parallel processing and split by date.
Electronic VAT return through ID-Porten with OAuth 2.0, VAT periods, VAT specifications and notes.
Remittance payments: remittance agreements and accounts, suggestions, payment orders, waiting journal, return files, error codes, and Telepay/BBS/SEPA export.
KID numbers and OCR payment import into the cash receipt journal, with OCR Journal - Test report and giro printing with OCR-B font.
EHF and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 e-invoicing for invoices, credit memos, reminders, finance charge memos and service documents.
Recurring orders from blanket orders via recurring groups and the Create Recurring Orders batch job; payroll import from Huldt & Lillevik Lønn and Visma.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian VAT codes and number fields to Gen. Journal Line, VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup and VAT Reporting Code. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gets proportional deduction and reverse charge procedures, and VAT Statement handles non-deductible parts. It also holds the SAF-T export (mapping, export, data check, setup wizard) and the electronic VAT return codeunits.
areas.why: Learn describes Norwegian VAT codes, proportional VAT, electronic VAT returns through ID-Porten and SAF-T files required by the authorities.

areas.what: Adds the remittance module: agreements, accounts, payment orders, waiting journal, return files, suggestion, test and export/import reports. Vendor, Vendor Templ., Vendor Ledger Entry and Purchase Header get remittance, KID and recipient reference fields. Also local vendor reports.
areas.why: Learn documents remittance setup, suggestions, export, return import, error codes and recipient reference codes for electronic vendor payments.

areas.what: Adds GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields to customers and to sales, reminder and finance charge documents. Sales & Receivables Setup gets KID and EHF path fields. PEPPOL Management and Validation are extended for reminders. Recurring orders add recurring groups, tables, pages and a batch report.
areas.why: Learn covers setting up customers for EHF, KID numbers on sales documents and recurring orders from blanket orders.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian extensions for service headers, lines, archives, invoices and credit memos, plus Norwegian service invoice, credit memo and shipment reports and posting/print codeunits.

Implements EHF e-invoicing: check and export codeunits for sales, reminder, finance charge and service documents, batch reports to create electronic documents, export tables, and an EHF Reminder xmlport. Also holds OCR setup and OCR payment import objects.
areas.why: Learn explains EHF for public sector invoices and OCR payment setup, import and test.

areas.what: Extends SEPA credit transfer export (events and procedures for waiting journal and payment order creation) and Payment Export Data with KID and urgent fields. Adds Pain.002 and CAMT.054 import, a Norwegian SEPA export file codeunit, and regulatory reporting codes with a threshold amount.
areas.why: Learn describes exporting remittance payments through SEPA, Telepay or BBS configured on the bank account.

areas.what: Adds PEPPOL BIS 3.0 support for Norway: management, subscribers, payment, install and upgrade codeunits, export codeunits for sales and service invoices and credit memos, xmlports, and a Norway value in the PEPPOL 3.0 format enum.
areas.why: Learn lists PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 and the E-Documents framework as Norwegian electronic invoicing options.

areas.what: Adds Enterpriseregister and a classification procedure on Company Information, extends Document-Print for sales orders, and adds SAF-T fields on source codes and company contact. Company-Initialize provides Norwegian SEPA CT code and name.
Adds the Application always Allowed field to User Setup, extends the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets, and extends the electronic VAT OAuth 2.0 setup.
areas.why: Learn explains that Application always Allowed in General Ledger Setup and User Setup lets users apply entries in closed periods.

areas.what: Adds a payroll integration codeunit and general journal page extensions for importing payroll transactions into journals.
areas.why: Learn describes importing payroll transactions from Huldt & Lillevik Lønn and Visma with the Payroll Data Definitions extension.

areas.what: Adds a DocumentTools codeunit and a SAF-T classification procedure in data classification of country data.
